what_this_is: The D-7 FRESH reference-control cohort 4: 300 rows, 100 per dimension, 50 positive and 50 negative each, each with its expected label, its kind and a row-level reason.
status: FROZEN — this is the set the panel is QUALIFIED on under instrument v4 (instrument v4). It is independent of cohorts 1, 2 and 3 and of the D4-50 reference set, and that independence is proved mechanically below.
why_a_fourth_cohort: cohort 1 was the set instrument v2 was developed against; cohort 2 was consumed by the v2 qualification and read for v3's diagnosis; cohort 3 was read during the v3 qualification and MiniCPM failed §4 bar 1 on it. A qualification set the instrument was read against is not independent of it.
purpose: (1) find a SECOND, INDEPENDENT, QUALIFIED scorer, since instrument v4 makes the defensive-context carve-out operative and the models that failed cohort 3 partly by over-flagging defensive content have a real chance now; (2) requalify adjudicator C, MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B, which failed §4 bar 1 on cohort 3 and whose shallow labels moved 1.6 pp from scorer A.

authorship.cohort_4_modules: Codex (gpt-6.1-sol), a lineage that is NOT a panel candidate, NOT the adjudicator and NOT the comparator.
authorship.d4_50_reference_set: the working model's own (MiniMax M3.1), because Codex refused that specific job; the refusal is recorded in ASTRA-D32 (4).
authorship.not_silent: every row here and in the D4-50 set is MODEL-AUTHORED. Nothing in this programme may describe either set as human reference.
